claims.claim: Pilot opened the first Megacharger station in Ellabell, Georgia with six stalls each rated up to 1.2 megawatts.
claims.episode_span: Pilot has opened the first of over a dozen Megacharger stations built with Tesla for electric Semis along major U.S. freight corridors.
claims.source_title: Tesla Is Building Megachargers For Semis Where Truckers Already Stop
claims.supporting_quote: The first Tesla Megacharger station is already operational at a Pilot location in Ellabell, Georgia, with a dozen more under construction across the country. The Ellabell Megacharger station features six stalls, each capable of delivering up to 1.2 megawatts of power to a Tesla Semi.
